A regular meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Davis at 5:32 p.m., on
Tuesday, September 12, 2023, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

REPORT ON COUNCIL  Councilmember Torosis reported that she traveled to St. Louis, MO to
TRAVEL  attend the National Local Progress Conference where she met with local
  elected officials from cities and school boards across the country. She
  stated that no City funds were expended on the event as the City is not an
  organizational member of National Local Progress; she did want to report

  2  September 12, 2023
   out on what information she will be bringing back to Santa Monica
  including but not limited to leveraging the ability of city attorneys to
  engage in affirmative litigation to deter bad actors; transitioning power in
  governing structures that work for more equitable representation; how to
  ensure equity in municipal bond finance so that when power shifts from
  local elected officials to bankers and bond attorneys, that officials can
  ensure that it is representative of the people they represent with alternative
  financing structures; further amplifying the demands of workers and
  improving working conditions to enact pro-worker policies in local
  jurisdictions; community based policing; and exploring the ideas of public
  utilities, public banks, and public grocery stores.

MANAGEMENT  move item 16.D. to be heard next. Motion passed unanimously with all
  Councilmembers present.

  activated devices to enforce noise limits on the Promenade, was
  continued to the 9/26/2023 Council meeting.

  withdrawing item (1) from consideration and only considering items (2),
  (3), and 4.

  Councilmember Negrete to move item 16.D., as amended, to be heard with
